layout: three-lobe chain with two overpass crossings; widths change from 62 to 114 px (kart scale 0.72 .. 1.33)

layers.rule: layer 0 = ground road (includes the narrow strand under each deck), layer 1 = deck. A kart switches layer by index: layer1_ranges in width_profile.json. Draw order: track, layer-0 karts, deck_overlay, layer-1 karts.

surfaces.off_road: none - outside the road is the fall zone (no slow zone)

fall.check: kart centre is outside the road mask of its own layer (layer 0: road_mask_layer0, layer 1: road_mask_layer1_deck), including a 3 px tolerance = fall_zone_mask for the open space
fall.respawn_rule: last respawn point passed along the lap; respawn on that point layer and with its kart_scale

chomp_hit.effect: spin 2 turns over 0.9 s, speed x0.4
chomp_hit.applies_when: kart on the same layer as the chomper and circle overlap (hitbox_radius_px * kart_scale)
chomp_hit.on_hit: the chomper keeps moving; play its charge_a frame for 0.25 s as a chomp animation (poof_0..3 are optional spare effects)

cogchomp_s.faces: east (right); rotate to heading, mirror vertically when heading left
cogchomp_s.roll: rotate the sprite about its centre by travelled_distance / radius radians (rolling ball) - optional

cogchomp_l.faces: east (right); rotate to heading, mirror vertically when heading left
cogchomp_l.roll: rotate the sprite about its centre by travelled_distance / radius radians (rolling ball) - optional

weave.note: lateral offset = amplitude * half_width(s) * sin(2*pi*s_travelled/period) so it stays on the road in narrow sections

lunge.windup: stand still, shake +-1.5 px at 14 Hz, charge_a/b frames, flame grows
lunge.lunge_rule: after the lunge it coasts back to roam speed over 0.4 s

chompers.scale_rule: scale sprite, hitbox and chain by kart_scale at the chomper own index (see width_profile.json)

chain.rule: links trail along the path behind the chomper, link k at distance (k+1)*spacing; harmless; alternate rotation 90 deg per link
